import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

p=argparse.ArgumentParser()
p.add_argument('--vm',required=True)
p.add_argument('--batch',type=int,default=0)
p.add_argument('--binary')
p.add_argument('--candidate',type=int)
p.add_argument('--seed',type=int,default=1234567)
p.add_argument('--pairs',type=int,default=7)
p.add_argument('--calls',type=int,default=200000)
p.add_argument('--name')
a=p.parse_args()
root=Path(__file__).parent
command=['/home/t3/.local/bin/boat','exec',a.vm,'--timeout','120','--','taskset','-c','0',f'/home/user/kuz-hybrid-positions/{a.binary or f"bench{a.batch}"}','--seed',str(a.seed),'--pairs',str(a.pairs),'--calls',str(a.calls)]
if a.candidate is not None: command+=['--candidate',str(a.candidate)]
r=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
stem=a.name or f'batch{a.batch}-seed{a.seed}'
(root/f'{stem}-receipt.json').write_text(r.stdout)
if r.stderr: print(r.stderr)
r.check_returncode()
data=json.loads(r.stdout)
assert data['success'],data
assert not data.get('stderrTruncated',False),data
(root/f'{stem}.jsonl').write_text(data['stderr'])
rows=[json.loads(s) for s in data['stderr'].splitlines()]
assert rows[1]['type']=='validation' and rows[1]['passed']
results=[row for row in rows if row['type']=='result']
for direction in ['encrypt','decrypt']:
    ranked=sorted([row for row in results if row['direction']==direction],key=lambda row:row['median_paired_ratio'])
    print(direction,'best',[(row['id'],row['label'],round(row['median_paired_ratio'],5),round(row['candidate_ns'],3)) for row in ranked[:6]])
    leading=[row for row in ranked if row['id']==0]
    if leading: print('framework control',direction,leading[0]['median_paired_ratio'])
